shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin climbed above $81,000, with some analysts suggesting the bear market bottom is confirmed.
Geopolitical escalation in the Middle East triggered a crypto sell-off, causing Bitcoin to drop by almost $2,000.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index currently registers 71 ("Greed").
Bitcoin demonstrated resilience after the Federal Reserve's recent rate hike, with liquidity appearing boosted.
The US Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act failed to advance, leading regulators to consider existing frameworks.
